show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/SDB2CG
show.description: Drishti, a famous screenwriter who hid her identity to marry Naitik. Treated like an unpaid maid and framed by his sister-in-law, she finally accepts a divorce. Reclaiming her status as a powerful heiress, Drishti returns to the spotlight to adapt her hit story for the big screen. As she rises, her past and present collide in a high-stakes tale of revenge and redemption.
